title: The Ouroboros Thesis v26 — Verifiable Append-Only Governance: Kernel-Proven Acyclicity, FIFO Ordering, and Monotonicity for AI Decision Receipts
description: v26 of the SZL Holdings Ouroboros thesis program (DOI-pinned lineage v1-v25): a machine-verified trust substrate for governed agentic AI built on the Ouroboros loop, the Lutar invariant Lambda, the Khipu receipt DAG, and a Lean 4 proof-trail architecture. Headline advance: the locked-proven set grows from 5 to EIGHT genuine, non-vacuous, sorry-free, kernel-verified theorems {F1, F4, F7, F11, F12, F18, F19, F22}, certified by the no-axiom theorem locked_count_eight. The three new locked formulas: F4 = Khipu DAG acyclicity preservation (appending a fresh node never creates a cycle); F7 = Chaski FIFO reception ordering (drain order = send order); F22 = Khipu emit append-only monotonicity (every emit strictly increases the ledger index — history is never rewritten). Lambda unconditional uniqueness remains machine-checked FALSE (maxAgg/min counterexamples) so Lambda stays Conjecture 1 — never a theorem; the CONDITIONAL uniqueness (Theorem U on {A1,A2,A3,A5}+slice-multiplicativity) is proven AXIOM-FREE (#print axioms = {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}). Khipu Byzantine BFT safety stays Conjecture 2 (Wave-23 proves a conditional quorum-agreement only). Honesty doctrine: locked-proven = EXACTLY 8; the experimental CI-green tier (~185 theorems, waves 11-22) is separate and never folded into the locked eight; kernel pinned at c7c0ba17; SLSA L1 honest, product images L2 build-attested (Sigstore keyless), L3 roadmap; nothing fabricated; trust never 100%. Only kernel-verified results are stated as proven. Related work engages the position-aware GNN / graph-structure lineage (You et al. P-GNN/GraphGym, SNAP pytorch_geometric, graph2nn) as prior art, reimplemented originally and governed.
